_comment: Cities for the guest sun/moon calendar (see lib/ephemeris.ts + app/sky-calendar). Adding a city is ONE entry here — no code change. `tz` is the IANA zone: it is the single source of truth for that city's local time AND its DST rules (astronomy-engine computes in UTC; we format into each city's own zone via Intl, so Berlin/Rome/London/Athens each get their correct offset, DST included, automatically). lat/lon in degrees (N/E positive); height in metres (0 is fine at sea level — negligible effect on rise/set). Order here is display order; Kos first (home).
